items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变等机制。文章重点介绍了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等先进体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在模拟ALS病理和药物筛选中的应用潜力。作者认为，这些新型人类模型有望帮助克服ALS治疗开发中的障碍。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS的病理视野从运动神经元扩展到血脑屏障和神经血管单元，并系统评估了患者来源细胞、3D共培养、微流控和类器官等人类模型平台。对于ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示BBB/NVU功能障碍可能是被低估的治疗靶点，同时这些先进模型可用于机制研究和药物筛选，弥补传统动物模型在人类相关性上的不足。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS中存在血脑屏障和神经血管单元功能障碍，与炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变相关；患者来源的2D、3D、微流控和类器官模型为研究这些改变和药物发现提供了新平台。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，未提供原始实验数据；所讨论的先进体外模型仍处于研究阶段，其能否准确再现体内ALS病理及预测临床疗效尚需验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性并最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB连同NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑内稳态，其多种细胞组分表现出功能受损，尤其与炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变相关。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控的平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障与神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受到关注的方向，并强调患者来源先进人类模型在机制研究与转化药物发现中的潜在价值。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失和Treg发育及功能受损，提示胸腺可能是ALS免疫失调的重要源头。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫机制从外周神经炎症前移到中枢免疫器官胸腺，提出胸腺退化可能是Treg功能衰竭的上游原因。对于关注ALS免疫调节治疗的研究者，这提示靶向胸腺或Treg发育通路可能成为新的干预方向，并值得在人类ALS中验证胸腺影像或功能标志物。

aiRead.keyFinding: SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠在疾病晚期出现胸腺萎缩、髓质胸腺上皮细胞丢失、Treg发育和抑制功能受损，提示胸腺是ALS免疫失调的靶器官。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1-G93A小鼠模型，尚未在人类ALS患者中验证，且胸腺改变与运动神经元丢失之间的因果关系未明确。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注人类ALS患者胸腺影像或胸腺输出功能标志物研究，以及靶向胸腺或Treg发育通路能否改善疾病进程的干预实验。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS期间调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能实验分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化的各个阶段和抑制能力。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质区域，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现将胸腺确定为ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调上游靶器官的作用，为理解Treg功能障碍和神经炎症提供了转化价值。

items.title: Exploring the toxicological impact of BDE-209 on neurodegenerative diseases through network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and in-vitro study.
items.summary: Decabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-209) is a persistent flame retardant associated with neurotoxicity, but its potential links to neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments to investigate BDE-209 in Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Network analysis identified 90 shared targets, enriched in lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory pathways, including IL-17 and TNF signaling. Docking prioritized the FKBP12-mTOR complex as a candidate binding system, with a score of -8.6 kcal/mol. MD simulations supported the stability of the predicted pose, which was dominated by van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions involving PHE-128 and TRP-190. In differentiated PC12 cells, BDE-209 increased p-mTOR at 10 μM and IL-1β at 20 μM without overt cytotoxicity. Rapamycin attenuated the p-mTOR response, supporting mTOR involvement, although mTOR dependence of IL-1β induction was not established. At 40 μM, BDE-209 reduced viability, potentially confounded by precipitation or aggregation. These findings implicate mTOR dysregulation in BDE-209 cellular responses, but direct binding, chronic exposure, and in vivo disease relevance require further validation.
items.titleZh: 通过网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外研究探索BDE-209对神经退行性疾病的毒理学影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究结合网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和PC12细胞实验，探讨持久性阻燃剂BDE-209与帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和ALS的潜在关联。分析发现90个共享靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路；FKBP12-mTOR复合物被预测为候选结合系统。细胞实验中BDE-209在10 μM升高p-mTOR、20 μM升高IL-1β，雷帕霉素可减弱p-mTOR反应，但IL-1β诱导是否依赖mTOR未确定；40 μM时细胞活力下降，可能存在沉淀或聚集干扰。研究提示mTOR失调可能参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性尚未验证。
items.insight: 该研究将环境毒物BDE-209与ALS等神经退行性疾病通过共享靶点和mTOR信号联系起来，为ALS环境风险因素研究提供了可检验的假说。虽然目前仅为体外细胞实验，但mTOR通路在ALS中已有一定研究基础，值得关注后续是否开展体内验证和慢性暴露研究。

items.abstractZh: 十溴二苯醚（BDE-209）是一种与神经毒性相关的持久性阻燃剂，但其与神经退行性疾病的潜在联系仍不清楚。我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和体外实验，研究BDE-209在帕金森病（PD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用。网络分析识别出90个共享靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路，包括IL-17和TNF信号通路。对接分析将FKBP12-mTOR复合物优先列为候选结合系统，评分为-8.6 kcal/mol。MD模拟支持预测构象的稳定性，该构象主要由涉及PHE-128和TRP-190的范德华力和疏水相互作用主导。在分化的PC12细胞中，BDE-209在10 μM时增加p-mTOR，在20 μM时增加IL-1β，且无明显细胞毒性。雷帕霉素减弱了p-mTOR反应，支持mTOR参与其中，但IL-1β诱导对mTOR的依赖性尚未确立。在40 μM时，BDE-209降低细胞活力，可能受到沉淀或聚集的混杂影响。这些发现提示mTOR失调参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需进一步验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合网络毒理学与体外实验，提示环境阻燃剂BDE-209可能通过mTOR失调与ALS相关，具有环境风险因素转化研究价值。

items.title: TBK1 overexpression reduces neuronal loss in the P497S UBQLN2 mouse model of ALS/FTD.
items.summary: Missense mutations in UBQLN2 are linked to dominant inheritance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which is frequently accompanied by frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The encoded UBQLN2 protein functions to maintain proteostasis, collapse of which is increasingly being realized as the cause of many neurodegenerative diseases. During investigations of our UBQLN2 mouse models of ALS/FTD, we observed a significant decline in Tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) protein in end-stage mice. The decline could be significant, as haploinsufficiency of TBK1 expression is linked to ALS/FTD. To determine whether the reduction in TBK1 levels is responsible for driving pathogenesis, we crossed P497S UBQLN2 transgenic (Tg) mice with BacTBK1 Tg mice that overexpress TBK1 and analyzed the progeny for signs of pathology. The analysis revealed that double transgenic mice had a significant reduction in neurodegeneration in both the brain and spinal cord (SC) compared to P497S single-Tg mice. Double immunofluorescence staining of P497S mouse tissue revealed TBK1 colocalizes with UBQLN2 aggregates in spinal motor neurons. Biochemical extraction studies of mouse brain tissue revealed increased enrichment of TBK1 along with wild type and mutant UBQLN2 proteins in detergent-insoluble material, suggesting TBK1 gets sequestered by UBQLN2 aggregates. GST-pulldown assays revealed that UBQLN2 binds directly with TBK1, but paradoxically the P497S mutation was found to reduce TBK1 binding. Turnover studies indicated that loss of UBQLN2 destabilizes TBK1, providing another route for its reduction. These findings lead us to propose that efforts directed toward increasing TBK1 expression may provide a therapeutic approach for treating ALS/FTD caused by UBQLN2 mutations.
items.titleZh: TBK1过表达可减少ALS/FTD的P497S UBQLN2小鼠模型中的神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在P497S UBQLN2转基因ALS/FTD小鼠模型中发现，终末期小鼠TBK1蛋白水平显著下降。通过将P497S UBQLN2小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1小鼠杂交，双转基因子代在脑和脊髓中的神经退行性变显著减少。机制上，TBK1与UBQLN2聚集体共定位并被隔离于去垢剂不溶性组分中；UBQLN2可直接结合TBK1，而P497S突变降低该结合；UBQLN2缺失导致TBK1不稳定。作者据此提出，提高TBK1表达可能成为UBQLN2突变所致ALS/FTD的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该研究将TBK1单倍剂量不足这一已知ALS/FTD遗传学证据与UBQLN2突变模型中的蛋白稳态失衡直接联系起来，提出TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离并因UBQLN2缺失而不稳定，从而为TBK1过表达作为UBQLN2相关ALS/FTD的干预策略提供了动物模型层面的机制依据。对关注蛋白稳态、聚集体清除和遗传性ALS/FTD治疗靶点的研究者具有跟踪价值。

items.abstractZh: UBQLN2的错义突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的显性遗传相关，且常伴随额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。所编码的UBQLN2蛋白功能在于维持蛋白稳态，而蛋白稳态的崩溃正日益被认为是许多神经退行性疾病的病因。在我们对ALS/FTD的UBQLN2小鼠模型进行研究期间，我们观察到终末期小鼠中Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）蛋白显著下降。这一下降可能具有重要意义，因为TBK1表达的单倍剂量不足与ALS/FTD相关。为确定TBK1水平的降低是否驱动了发病机制，我们将P497S UBQLN2转基因（Tg）小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1 Tg小鼠杂交，并分析子代是否存在病理迹象。分析显示，与P497S单转基因小鼠相比，双转基因小鼠在脑和脊髓（SC）中的神经退行性变均显著减少。对P497S小鼠组织的双重免疫荧光染色显示，TBK1与脊髓运动神经元中的UBQLN2聚集体共定位。对小鼠脑组织的生化提取研究显示，TBK1与野生型和突变型UBQLN2蛋白在去垢剂不溶性物质中富集增加，提示TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离。GST下拉实验显示UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，但矛盾的是，P497S突变反而降低了TBK1的结合。周转研究提示UBQLN2的缺失使TBK1不稳定，为其减少提供了另一条途径。这些发现使我们提出，旨在增加TBK1表达的努力可能为治疗由UBQLN2突变引起的ALS/FTD提供一种治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在UBQLN2突变型ALS/FTD小鼠模型中证明过表达TBK1可减轻神经退行性变，为TBK1这一ALS/FTD遗传学核心分子提供了新的转化干预依据。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征及治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，并与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼联合槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能和运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤，并保留皮层V层神经元。皮层小胶质细胞可能是介导这些获益的关键细胞。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期、可干预的病理特征。
items.insight: 这项研究将细胞衰老定位为ALS的早期可修饰特征，并提供了衰老细胞清除药物在遗传性ALS小鼠模型中的纵向干预证据。其价值在于：第一，衰老标志物与功能下降同步出现，提示衰老可能是驱动疾病进展的早期机制而非终末现象；第二，D&Q治疗在运动行为、神经肌肉功能、血浆NfL和皮层兴奋性等多个层面显示获益，为衰老细胞清除策略的临床转化提供了临床前依据；第三，小胶质细胞被识别为潜在介导细胞，连接了衰老、神经炎症和TDP-43病理。后续需在更多模型和临床中验证。

aiRead.studyType: 动物模型干预研究（TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠，纵向衰老细胞清除治疗）
aiRead.keyFinding: 细胞衰老标志物在ALS小鼠运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现；达沙替尼联合槲皮素治疗改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能、运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤并保留V层神经元，小胶质细胞可能是介导细胞。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于单一TDP-43 Q331K小鼠模型，尚不能确定结果是否适用于其他ALS遗传亚型或散发性ALS；衰老细胞清除治疗在人类中的安全性、耐受性和疗效尚未验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该衰老细胞清除策略在其他ALS模型中的重复验证，以及是否推进至临床早期试验；同时关注小胶质细胞衰老在ALS中的具体分子机制和生物标志物开发。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持细胞衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了通过血浆神经丝轻链测得的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现将细胞衰老确定为ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中证明细胞衰老是疾病早期可修饰特征，衰老细胞清除治疗可改善功能并降低NfL，为ALS的衰老靶向转化策略提供了新近的临床前证据。

items.title: Motor coordination and behavioural deficits in a mouse model of KMT2B-related dystonia.
items.summary: Pathogenic variants in KMT2B cause early-onset dystonia, but a mouse model that has undergone comprehensive, dystonia-oriented phenotyping is lacking. We conducted detailed phenotyping on heterozygous Kmt2b constitutive knockout mice and wild-type littermates, assessing growth, neurobehavioural traits, motor coordination, sensorimotor gating, social behaviour and metabolic parameters, combined with striatal RNA sequencing. Kmt2b knockout mice of both sexes were viable but significantly smaller and lighter than littermate controls. Knockouts were hyperlocomotive in the open field and showed approximately two-fold larger acoustic startle responses; unexpectedly, prepulse inhibition was enhanced rather than reduced at all prepulse intensities. On the balance beam, knockouts crossed more slowly and paused more frequently; female knockouts also paused more on the ladder rung task. Frame-by-frame video analysis revealed a claw-like hindpaw posture characterized by abnormal inward flexion of the digits. Knockout mice spent less time investigating a novel conspecific, while social recognition memory remained intact. Striatal RNA sequencing confirmed reduction of Kmt2b transcript to approximately half of control levels and identified 177 differentially expressed genes, including Maob, encoding monoamine oxidase B; gene set enrichment analysis implicated neurodevelopmental, glial and mitochondrial processes. Nociception, vision, body-weight-adjusted grip strength, and clinical chemistry and haematological measures were largely unaffected. Heterozygous Kmt2b knockout mice show hyperlocomotion, altered sensorimotor gating, impaired motor coordination with dystonic-like paw posturing and reduced sociability, alongside a striatal transcriptomic signature implicating neurodevelopmental processes. The model mirrors aspects of human KMT2B-related dystonia and provides a platform for mechanistic study; environmental or pharmacological challenge may be needed to unmask overt dystonic features.
items.titleZh: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍小鼠模型中的运动协调与行为缺陷
items.summaryZh: 该研究对杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠进行了系统的肌张力障碍相关表型分析，发现其存在活动过度、惊跳反应增强、前脉冲抑制反常增强、平衡木和梯级任务运动协调受损、爪样后爪姿势及社交探索减少，纹状体转录组显示Kmt2b表达减半并涉及神经发育、胶质和线粒体相关通路。该模型部分再现人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍特征，但未出现明显自发性肌张力障碍，提示可能需要额外挑战才能显现。
items.insight: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍与ALS同属神经退行性运动障碍，其纹状体转录组中神经发育、胶质和线粒体通路的改变，以及Maob等差异基因，可能为理解ALS中纹状体-运动环路受累、线粒体功能障碍和胶质反应提供可借鉴的机制线索；该模型也为测试环境或药物挑战能否揭示隐匿性运动表型提供了平台。

aiRead.studyType: 动物模型研究（杂合Kmt2b组成型敲除小鼠表型分析与纹状体RNA测序）
aiRead.keyFinding: Kmt2b敲除小鼠表现出活动过度、感觉运动门控改变、运动协调受损、肌张力障碍样爪姿势和社交能力下降，纹状体转录组提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程受累，但未出现明显自发性肌张力障碍。
aiRead.limitation: 该模型仅部分再现人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍特征，未出现明显自发性肌张力障碍，可能需要环境或药物挑战才能揭示；且为动物研究，不能直接推断临床疗效或人类疾病机制。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注该模型在环境或药物挑战下是否出现更明显的肌张力障碍表型，以及纹状体Maob等差异基因和线粒体、胶质通路是否可成为干预靶点。

items.abstractZh: KMT2B的致病性变异可导致早发性肌张力障碍，但目前尚缺乏经过全面、以肌张力障碍为导向的表型分析的小鼠模型。我们对杂合Kmt2b组成型敲除小鼠及其野生型同窝对照进行了详细表型分析，评估了生长、神经行为特征、运动协调、感觉运动门控、社会行为和代谢参数，并结合纹状体RNA测序。两种性别的Kmt2b敲除小鼠均可存活，但显著小于且轻于同窝对照。敲除小鼠在旷场中活动过度，听觉惊跳反应约增大两倍；出乎意料的是，在所有前脉冲强度下，前脉冲抑制均增强而非减弱。在平衡木上，敲除小鼠通过速度更慢、停顿更频繁；雌性敲除小鼠在梯级任务中也停顿更多。逐帧视频分析揭示了一种爪样后爪姿势，其特征为趾部异常向内弯曲。敲除小鼠探索新异同种个体的时间减少，而社会识别记忆保持完整。纹状体RNA测序证实Kmt2b转录本降至对照水平约一半，并鉴定出177个差异表达基因，包括编码单胺氧化酶B的Maob；基因集富集分析提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程。痛觉、视觉、体重校正后的握力以及临床化学和血液学指标基本未受影响。杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠表现出活动过度、感觉运动门控改变、运动协调受损伴肌张力障碍样爪姿势以及社交能力下降，同时具有提示神经发育过程的纹状体转录组特征。该模型反映了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍的某些方面，并为机制研究提供了平台；可能需要环境或药物挑战才能揭示明显的肌张力障碍特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该新近动物模型首次对Kmt2b杂合敲除小鼠进行系统肌张力障碍导向表型分析，并揭示纹状体神经发育、胶质和线粒体相关转录组特征，为ALS等神经退行性运动障碍的机制研究提供转化参考。

items.title: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle phosphorylated TDP-43 as a blood-based biomarker for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by central nervous system (CNS) neuroglial TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology in ∼90-95% of cases. Non-invasive biomarkers are critically needed to reduce diagnostic delay, enable patient stratification, and assess treatment efficacy in clinical trials. Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) represent promising CNS liquid biopsy biomarkers, given astrocyte involvement in ALS pathogenesis and the ability of ADEVs to cross the blood-brain barrier and carry TDP-43. Here, we assessed the diagnostic performance of TDP-43 and its hyperphosphorylated pathological form, phospho-Ser409 (pTDP-43), quantified in ADEVs, for distinguishing ALS cases from matched healthy controls. ADEVs were immunoisolated from whole blood (n = 76) and plasma (n = 86) across three ALS biorepositories/cohorts. ADEV quality and enrichment were validated in accordance with minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles guidelines, and protein levels were normalized by ratio to tetraspanin cluster of differentiation 81 (CD81). Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated by logistic regression and random forest models with cross-validation, adjusting for age and sex across 100 random seeds. Plasma ADEV pTDP-43/CD81 ratio best predicted ALS case status, with a mean AUC of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.75-0.99) from logistic models, corresponding to a mean sensitivity and specificity of 87% and 89%, respectively, and a mean AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.90) from random forest models. Although the specificity of ADEV pTDP-43 relative to disease mimics and associations with disease progression require further investigation, these findings support its potential as a biomarker candidate for ALS and for patient stratification in TDP-43-targeted clinical trials.
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡中磷酸化TDP-43作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的血源性生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了血浆星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）中磷酸化TDP-43（pTDP-43）作为ALS血源性生物标志物的诊断性能。在三个独立队列中，血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值区分ALS与健康对照的平均AUC达0.89，敏感性和特异性分别约为87%和89%。该标志物有望用于减少诊断延迟、患者分层及TDP-43靶向临床试验的疗效评估，但其对疾病模拟者的特异性及与疾病进展的关联尚待验证。
items.insight: 这项研究提供了一种基于血液的ALS候选生物标志物，通过检测星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡中的病理形式TDP-43，可能实现非侵入性诊断和患者分层。其与TDP-43靶向治疗试验的潜在结合点值得关注，但需在更大、更多样化队列中验证特异性及与疾病进展的关联。

aiRead.studyType: 多队列诊断准确性研究（生物标志物验证）
aiRead.keyFinding: 血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值在区分ALS与健康对照中达到平均AUC 0.89，敏感性和特异性分别约为87%和89%。
aiRead.limitation: 未充分评估对疾病模拟者的特异性，且与疾病进展的关联尚未明确，样本量有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 在独立、多样化队列中验证诊断特异性，并评估其与疾病进展及TDP-43靶向治疗反应的关联。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，约90-95%的病例以中枢神经系统（CNS）神经胶质细胞中TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理为特征。目前迫切需要非侵入性生物标志物以减少诊断延迟、实现患者分层并评估临床试验中的治疗效果。鉴于星形胶质细胞参与ALS发病机制，且星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）能够穿越血脑屏障并携带TDP-43，ADEVs代表了一种有前景的中枢神经系统液体活检生物标志物。本研究评估了在ADEVs中定量的TDP-43及其过度磷酸化病理形式——磷酸化Ser409（pTDP-43）在区分ALS病例与匹配健康对照中的诊断性能。ADEVs从三个ALS生物样本库/队列的全血（n=76）和血浆（n=86）中免疫分离。ADEV质量和富集度按照细胞外囊泡研究最低信息指南进行验证，蛋白水平通过与外泌体标志物分化簇81（CD81）的比值进行归一化。诊断准确性通过逻辑回归和随机森林模型结合交叉验证进行评估，并在100个随机种子中调整年龄和性别。血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值最能预测ALS病例状态，逻辑回归模型的平均AUC为0.89（95% CI：0.75-0.99），对应的平均敏感性和特异性分别为87%和89%，随机森林模型的平均AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.82-0.90）。尽管ADEV pTDP-43相对于疾病模拟者的特异性以及与疾病进展的关联仍需进一步研究，但这些发现支持其作为ALS生物标志物候选物以及用于TDP-43靶向临床试验中患者分层的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究报道了一种新近的、与ALS核心病理TDP-43直接相关的血源性生物标志物候选物，具有用于患者分层和TDP-43靶向临床试验的转化价值。

items.title: Long-term exposure to ultrafine particles and mortality from neurodegenerative diseases: a population-based cohort study.
items.summary: Transportation and industrial activities emit large quantities of air pollutants, including unregulated ultrafine particles (UFP, <0.1 um), which may adversely affect brain health. We analyzed data from 2.1 million adults in the Canadian Census Health and Environment Cohorts (CanCHECs) living in Montreal and Toronto (2001-2019). Vital status and primary cause of death were obtained from the Canadian Vital Statistics- Death database. We assigned high-resolution estimates of UFP number concentrations and UFP size to participants' residential postal codes using three-year moving averages. Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimates hazard ratios (HRs) between long-term outdoor UFP number concentrations and mortality from dementia, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We further examined associations by dementia sub-types including Alzheimer's disease, vascular dementia and unspecified dementia. Models were used with and without inverse probability of censoring weights for competing events, and adjusted for UFP size, sociodemographic factors, and co-pollutants. Over 19 million person-years, we identified 20,560 deaths from neurodegenerative diseases. Each 10,000 particle/cm 3 increase in UFP number concentrations was associated with increased dementia mortality (HR = 1.22, 95% CI: 1.17-1.27), with stronger associations observed after adjusting for UFP size. Positive associations were observed for all dementia subtypes, with the largest for vascular dementia (HR = 1.49, 95% CI: 1.27-1.76). We did not observe effects of UFP on mortality from Parkinson's disease or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Long-term exposure to outdoor UFPs may contribute to mortality from specific neurodegenerative diseases, particularly dementia. Reducing population exposures to these unregulated pollutants could help mitigate the burden of neurodegenerative mortality.
items.titleZh: 长期暴露于超细颗粒物与神经退行性疾病死亡率：一项基于人群的队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项基于加拿大210万成年人的大型队列研究发现，长期暴露于室外超细颗粒物（UFP）与痴呆死亡率升高相关，尤其是血管性痴呆，但未发现与帕金森病或肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）死亡率存在关联。研究提示空气污染对神经退行性疾病的影响可能具有疾病特异性。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS领域提供了重要的阴性对照证据：在同样的大型人群队列和暴露评估框架下，UFP与痴呆死亡率显著相关，却未观察到与ALS死亡率的关联。这有助于界定空气污染在ALS病因学中的可能作用范围，提示ALS的环境风险因素可能不同于痴呆，或需要更精细的暴露窗口和剂量评估。对于关注环境暴露与ALS关系的学者，该研究的阴性结果与痴呆的阳性结果形成对比，值得作为假设生成和后续研究设计的参考。

aiRead.studyType: 基于人群的回顾性队列研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 长期室外UFP暴露与痴呆死亡率升高相关（每10,000粒子/cm³的HR=1.22），但未观察到与帕金森病或ALS死亡率的关联。
aiRead.limitation: 暴露评估基于居住邮政编码和三年移动平均值，可能存在暴露错分；仅评估死亡率而非发病率；ALS死亡病例数可能较少导致统计效能不足；观察性设计无法确立因果关系。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究可关注：更精细的ALS暴露评估（如职业暴露、个体监测）、不同时间窗口的暴露效应、以及UFP与其他空气污染物交互作用对ALS风险的影响。

items.abstractZh: 交通运输和工业活动排放大量空气污染物，包括未受监管的超细颗粒物（UFP，<0.1微米），可能对大脑健康产生不良影响。我们分析了加拿大人口普查健康与环境队列（CanCHECs）中居住在蒙特利尔和多伦多的210万成年人数据（2001-2019年）。生命状态和主要死因来自加拿大生命统计-死亡数据库。我们使用三年移动平均值，将高分辨率UFP数浓度和UFP粒径估计值分配给参与者的居住邮政编码。采用Cox比例风险模型估计长期室外UFP数浓度与痴呆、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化死亡率之间的风险比（HRs）。我们进一步按痴呆亚型（包括阿尔茨海默病、血管性痴呆和未特指痴呆）检查了关联。模型分别采用和不采用针对竞争事件的删失逆概率加权，并调整了UFP粒径、社会人口学因素和共污染物。在超过1900万人年的随访中，我们识别出20,560例神经退行性疾病死亡。UFP数浓度每增加10,000个粒子/立方厘米，与痴呆死亡率增加相关（HR = 1.22，95% CI：1.17-1.27），在调整UFP粒径后观察到更强的关联。所有痴呆亚型均观察到正相关，其中血管性痴呆关联最强（HR = 1.49，95% CI：1.27-1.76）。我们未观察到UFP对帕金森病或肌萎缩侧索硬化死亡率的影响。长期暴露于室外UFP可能促成特定神经退行性疾病的死亡率，尤其是痴呆。减少人群对这些未受监管污染物的暴露可能有助于减轻神经退行性疾病死亡负担。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用210万人群队列和19百万person-years随访，新近提供了超细颗粒物暴露与ALS死亡率无关联的阴性证据，对界定ALS环境风险因素具有转化参考价值。

items.title: Decoupling metabolic defense: Mutational and recombinational chaos in Sod1-deficient cells.
items.summary: Superoxide dismutase 1 (Sod1) is long recognized as a frontline antioxidant, yet its broader role in safeguarding the eukaryotic genome remains under-explored. Here, using a yeast model, we reveal that Sod1 is an indispensable guardian of genomic integrity. Its absence unleashes a genomic storm: whole-genome sequencing uncovered a dramatic surge in single nucleotide variations (13-fold), loss of heterozygosity (12-fold), chromosomal rearrangements (4-fold), and a staggering 48-fold increase in aneuploidy. Remarkably, this genomic instability was completely abolished under anaerobic conditions, identifying reactive oxygen species as the sole executioner. We demonstrate that Sod1 deficiency sculpts a unique mutational landscape dominated by C:G to A:T transversions-a molecular fingerprint of 8-oxoguanine overproduction. Mechanistically, these lesions are exacerbated by error-prone DNA polymerase ζ but mitigated by the concerted actions of Ogg1-mediated excision and DNA polymerase η. Critically, we show that Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis-associated variants are not created equal: the H48Q mutation shatters genome stability, whereas others (A4V, G36R, and G93A) remain benign in this context. Unlike yeast Sod1, human Sod1 is highly resistant to amino acid substitutions outside copper-binding sites, thus preventing the loss of enzyme function. Overall, our findings provide a mechanistically framework for understanding how Sod1 dysfunction drives genome instability in eukaryotic cells.
items.titleZh: 解耦代谢防御：Sod1缺陷细胞中的突变与重组混乱
items.summaryZh: 该研究利用酵母模型发现，Sod1缺失会导致严重的基因组不稳定性，包括单核苷酸变异、杂合性丢失、染色体重排和非整倍体大幅增加，且这一过程完全由活性氧介导。研究进一步揭示，不同ALS相关SOD1突变对基因组稳定性的影响差异显著：H48Q突变破坏基因组稳定性，而A4V、G36R和G93A在此模型中表现良性。人SOD1对铜结合位点外的氨基酸替换具有高度耐受性，可能防止酶功能丧失。
items.insight: 这项研究为理解SOD1突变如何通过基因组不稳定性参与ALS发病提供了机制框架，并强调不同SOD1突变的功能后果存在显著异质性。对于ALS研究者而言，它提示在评估SOD1靶向治疗时，需考虑突变特异性效应，而非将所有SOD1突变等同对待。

aiRead.keyFinding: Sod1缺失通过活性氧导致基因组不稳定性，且不同ALS相关SOD1突变对基因组稳定性的影响存在显著差异。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于酵母模型，结论外推到人类ALS病理需谨慎；未在人类神经元或动物模型中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究可在人类细胞或动物模型中验证H48Q突变特异性破坏基因组稳定性的机制，并探索针对不同SOD1突变的精准干预策略。

items.abstractZh: 超氧化物歧化酶1（Sod1）长期以来被认为是前线抗氧化剂，但其在保护真核基因组方面的更广泛作用仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们利用酵母模型揭示，Sod1是基因组完整性的不可或缺的守护者。其缺失引发基因组风暴：全基因组测序发现单核苷酸变异急剧增加（13倍）、杂合性丢失（12倍）、染色体重排（4倍），以及非整倍体惊人地增加48倍。值得注意的是，这种基因组不稳定性在厌氧条件下完全消失，表明活性氧是唯一的执行者。我们证明，Sod1缺陷塑造了一种独特的突变景观，以C:G到A:T颠换为主——这是8-氧代鸟嘌呤过量产生的分子指纹。在机制上，这些损伤被易出错的DNA聚合酶ζ加剧，但被Ogg1介导的切除和DNA聚合酶η的协同作用所减轻。关键的是，我们表明肌萎缩侧索硬化相关的变异并非同等：H48Q突变破坏基因组稳定性，而其他变异（A4V、G36R和G93A）在此背景下保持良性。与酵母Sod1不同，人Sod1对铜结合位点以外的氨基酸替换具有高度抗性，从而防止酶功能丧失。总体而言，我们的发现为理解Sod1功能障碍如何驱动真核细胞基因组不稳定性提供了一个机制框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了SOD1缺陷驱动基因组不稳定的机制，并区分了不同ALS相关SOD1突变的效应差异，对理解SOD1-ALS的转化研究具有参考价值。

items.title: Neuroimaging signatures of facial onset sensory and motor neuronopathy (FOSMN).
items.summary: Facial onset sensory and motor neuronopathy (FOSMN) is an exceptionally rare condition characterized by progressive facial paresthesia and the subsequent appearance of bulbar symptoms with rostro-caudal motor and sensory deficits sometimes extending to the hand muscles. The pathophysiological understanding of this disorder is very limited. In order to identify patterns of neuroanatomical involvement within the brain, we applied advanced magnetic resonance imaging-based techniques to a group of six patients with the diagnosis of FOSMN, using unbiased analysis techniques with atlas-based volumetry of volume-rendering T1-weighted data and whole brain-based spatial statistics of diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). The volumetric data showed significant global atrophy with prominent involvement of the medulla oblongata, while DTI demonstrated significant decreases in the right-hemispheric frontal lobe and bilaterally along the superior and inferior longitudinal fasciculi. In summary, this application of volumetry and DTI to a group of FOSMN patients demonstrated, beyond global brain atrophy as a correlate of a systemic disease process, regional atrophy in the brainstem/medulla oblongata, together with tract alterations of polymodal frontotemporoparietal interconnections. Future neuroimaging studies in larger patient groups of FOSMN are needed for detailed phenotype-neuroimaging correlations.
items.titleZh: 面部起病的感觉运动神经元病（FOSMN）的神经影像学特征
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究对6例FOSMN患者进行了脑部MRI体积测量和弥散张量成像分析，发现患者存在全脑萎缩，其中延髓区域萎缩尤为突出，同时右侧额叶及双侧上、下纵束出现弥散指标异常。研究提示FOSMN不仅累及脑干和延髓，还涉及额颞顶叶之间的多模态连接通路。作者指出，未来需要更大样本的研究来建立影像学与临床表型之间的对应关系。
items.insight: FOSMN与ALS在临床和病理上存在重叠，常被纳入ALS谱系疾病讨论。该研究首次系统性地将图谱体积测量与全脑DTI空间统计联合应用于FOSMN，揭示了延髓区域性萎缩和额颞顶叶长程联络纤维束的改变，为理解FOSMN的神经解剖受累模式提供了影像学依据。尽管样本量极小（6例），但所采用的影像分析流程和发现的受累区域（延髓、纵束）可为ALS影像标志物研究提供参照，尤其是关于脑干和长程白质通路在运动神经元病中的角色。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床研究（横断面神经影像学研究，6例患者）
aiRead.keyFinding: FOSMN患者存在全脑萎缩，以延髓区域性萎缩为突出表现，同时右侧额叶及双侧上、下纵束DTI指标显著异常，提示脑干和额颞顶叶多模态连接通路受累。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量极小（仅6例），无对照组，无法进行表型-影像学相关性分析，且为横断面设计，不能推断因果关系或纵向变化。
aiRead.watchNext: 未来在更大规模FOSMN队列中验证这些影像学特征，并探索其与ALS影像标志物的重叠程度及诊断/预后价值。

items.abstractZh: 面部起病的感觉运动神经元病（FOSMN）是一种极为罕见的疾病，其特征为进行性面部感觉异常，随后出现延髓症状，并伴有自头侧向尾侧进展的运动和感觉缺损，有时可累及手部肌肉。目前对该疾病病理生理机制的理解非常有限。为了识别大脑内神经解剖受累的模式，我们对一组六例诊断为FOSMN的患者应用了先进的磁共振成像技术，采用无偏倚分析方法，包括基于体积渲染T1加权数据的图谱体积测量以及基于全脑的弥散张量成像（DTI）空间统计。体积测量数据显示存在显著的全局性脑萎缩，以延髓受累为突出表现；而DTI显示右侧额叶以及双侧上、下纵束沿线的显著改变。总之，将体积测量和DTI应用于一组FOSMN患者，除了显示作为全身性疾病过程相关因素的全局性脑萎缩外，还证明了脑干/延髓的区域性萎缩，以及多模态额颞顶叶互联通路的束路改变。未来需要在更大规模FOSMN患者群体中进行神经影像学研究，以实现详细的表型-神经影像学相关性分析。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用先进的MRI体积测量和DTI技术，在极罕见的FOSMN中揭示了延髓区域性萎缩和额颞顶叶联络纤维束改变，为ALS谱系疾病的神经影像标志物研究提供了新近的转化线索。

items.title: Targeting lysosomal dysfunction with small-molecule TRPML1 ligands: Therapeutic opportunities in lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration and beyond.
items.summary: TRPML1, a lysosomal Ca 2+ channel, has emerged as a clinically relevant target due to its genetic and mechanistic links to lysosomal storage disorders and neurodegenerative diseases, including Gaucher disease, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. This evidence has prompted TRPML1 drug discovery efforts across academia and industry, with several small-molecule agonists advancing toward clinical development. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of the therapeutic potential of TRPML1 as a molecular target from a medicinal chemistry perspective. We summarize the structural basis of channel activation and inhibition, highlighting insights from recent cryo-EM studies that define the principal ligand-binding sites and mechanisms of allosteric modulation. We systematically survey the chemical space of TRPML1 ligands reported to date, including diverse agonist and antagonist chemotypes, and extend this analysis to encompass undisclosed or recently disclosed compounds emerging from industry pipelines. Furthermore, we discuss key determinants of ligand design and developability, including the challenges associated with targeting a deeply embedded, lipophilic binding pocket within the membrane. Overall, the available evidence positions TRPML1 as a promising target for small-molecule drug discovery and provides a framework for the rational design of next-generation lysosome-directed therapeutics.
items.titleZh: 靶向溶酶体功能障碍的小分子TRPML1配体：在溶酶体贮积症、神经退行性疾病及其他疾病中的治疗机遇
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述从药物化学角度系统梳理了溶酶体钙通道TRPML1作为治疗靶点的研究进展。TRPML1与戈谢病、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病及肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病存在遗传和机制关联，目前已有多个小分子激动剂向临床开发推进。文章总结了TRPML1激活与抑制的结构基础（包括冷冻电镜研究揭示的配体结合位点和变构调节机制），系统调查了已报道的激动剂和拮抗剂化学型，并纳入工业管线中未公开或新公开的化合物。文章还讨论了靶向膜内深埋亲脂性结合口袋的配体设计与可开发性挑战，为下一代溶酶体导向疗法的合理设计提供了框架。
items.insight: 该综述将TRPML1置于ALS相关神经退行性疾病的治疗靶点框架中，系统整合了结构生物学（冷冻电镜）、药物化学和工业管线信息。对于ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：溶酶体功能障碍是ALS的重要病理机制之一，而TRPML1作为溶酶体钙通道的调控节点，可能通过改善溶酶体功能影响疾病进程。文章提供的配体化学空间和设计策略可为开发针对ALS的溶酶体导向小分子提供参考，但需注意目前证据主要来自临床前研究，尚无临床疗效验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: TRPML1因与溶酶体贮积症及包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病的遗传和机制关联而成为临床相关靶点，已有多个小分子激动剂向临床开发推进；冷冻电镜研究揭示了配体结合位点和变构调节机制，为合理设计下一代溶酶体导向疗法提供了结构基础。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，不提供原始实验数据或临床疗效结果；所提及的化合物多处于临床前或早期临床开发阶段，靶向膜内深埋亲脂性结合口袋仍存在配体设计和可开发性挑战。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注文中提及的TRPML1小分子激动剂在临床开发中的进展，以及工业管线中未公开或新公开化合物的后续披露；同时关注TRPML1调控在ALS相关溶酶体功能障碍模型中的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: TRPML1是一种溶酶体Ca2+通道，由于其与溶酶体贮积症和神经退行性疾病（包括戈谢病、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）的遗传和机制联系，已成为一个临床相关靶点。这些证据推动了学术界和工业界针对TRPML1的药物发现工作，已有多个小分子激动剂向临床开发推进。在这篇综述中，我们从药物化学角度全面概述了TRPML1作为分子靶点的治疗潜力。我们总结了通道激活和抑制的结构基础，重点介绍了近期冷冻电镜研究的见解，这些研究确定了主要的配体结合位点和变构调节机制。我们系统地调查了迄今为止报道的TRPML1配体的化学空间，包括多种激动剂和拮抗剂化学型，并将此分析扩展到涵盖来自工业管线中未公开或最近公开的化合物。此外，我们讨论了配体设计和可开发性的关键决定因素，包括靶向膜内深埋的亲脂性结合口袋所面临的挑战。总体而言，现有证据将TRPML1定位为小分子药物发现的有前景靶点，并为合理设计下一代溶酶体导向疗法提供了框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了近期冷冻电镜结构研究与工业管线化合物信息，系统阐述了TRPML1作为溶酶体导向治疗靶点在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的转化潜力。

items.title: PAICS mediates DNA damage and cerebellar neuronal loss in C9orf72 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: A hexanucleotide (GGGGCC) repeat expansion in the C9orf72 gene represents the most frequent genetic cause of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), resulting in reduced C9orf72 mRNA and protein expression. C9orf72 is highly expressed in the cerebellum, and growing evidence implicates C9orf72-associated cerebellar pathology across neurodegenerative disorders, including ALS/FTD, yet the pathogenic mechanisms remain unresolved. Here, we demonstrate that in vivo C9orf72 loss of function leads to cerebellar atrophy, loss of GABAergic interneurons and depletion of Purkinje and granule cells. Additionally, we demonstrate that these cerebellar anomalies precede motor defects. Single-cell transcriptomics of the C9orf72 zebrafish brain revealed the downregulation of a purine biosynthetic gene, paics, in Purkinje cells. Furthermore, we demonstrate the reduced expression of PAICS in human post-mortem cerebellar sections and induced pluripotent stem cell-derived motor neurons from C9orf72 and sporadic ALS patients. Knockout of paics in zebrafish recapitulates cerebellar neuronal loss, neuromuscular junction disruption, motor impairment and widespread DNA damage and repair defects, including suppression of key DNA repair pathways. Restoring paics expression in C9orf72 zebrafish resolves DNA damage and preserves Purkinje cells and granule cells, revealing PAICS as a crucial mediator of cerebellar degeneration and a promising therapeutic avenue for C9orf72-associated ALS and FTD.
items.evidenceLevel: 临床前研究（动物模型、患者组织及iPSC验证）
items.titleZh: PAICS介导C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化中的DNA损伤与小脑神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在C9orf72功能缺失模型中揭示小脑萎缩和神经元丢失先于运动症状出现，单细胞转录组发现浦肯野细胞中嘌呤合成基因paics下调；在患者小脑组织和iPSC来源运动神经元中验证PAICS表达降低；斑马鱼敲除paics可重现小脑神经元丢失、神经肌肉接头破坏和DNA损伤修复缺陷；恢复paics表达可减轻DNA损伤并保护小脑神经元，提示PAICS是C9orf72相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗靶点。
items.insight: 该研究将C9orf72相关ALS的病理机制从运动系统拓展至小脑，提出PAICS介导的DNA损伤修复缺陷是早期小脑神经元丢失的关键环节，且恢复PAICS可逆转表型，为C9orf72相关ALS/FTD提供了新的治疗靶点和早期干预窗口。

aiRead.keyFinding: C9orf72功能缺失导致小脑神经元丢失先于运动缺陷，PAICS下调介导DNA损伤，恢复paics表达可保护小脑神经元。

items.abstractZh: C9orf72基因中的六核苷酸（GGGGCC）重复扩增是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）最常见的遗传病因，导致C9orf72 mRNA和蛋白表达降低。C9orf72在小脑中高表达，越来越多的证据表明C9orf72相关小脑病理参与多种神经退行性疾病，包括ALS/FTD，但其致病机制尚未明确。在此，我们证明体内C9orf72功能缺失导致小脑萎缩、GABA能中间神经元丢失以及浦肯野细胞和颗粒细胞耗竭。此外，我们证明这些小脑异常先于运动缺陷出现。C9orf72斑马鱼脑的单细胞转录组学揭示浦肯野细胞中嘌呤生物合成基因paics的下调。此外，我们证明在C9orf72和散发性ALS患者的人死后小脑切片及诱导多能干细胞来源的运动神经元中PAICS表达降低。在斑马鱼中敲除paics可重现小脑神经元丢失、神经肌肉接头破坏、运动障碍以及广泛的DNA损伤和修复缺陷，包括关键DNA修复通路的抑制。在C9orf72斑马鱼中恢复paics表达可解决DNA损伤并保护浦肯野细胞和颗粒细胞，揭示PAICS是小脑变性的关键介质，也是C9orf72相关ALS和FTD的有前景的治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了PAICS作为C9orf72相关ALS/FTD中小脑变性和DNA损伤的关键介质，具有明确的转化潜力。

items.title: Constitutive neuronal expression and disease-associated upregulation of chitinases in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Chitinases are hydrolytic enzymes responsible for degrading chitin and have been evolutionarily conserved across various species. Although their signalling pathways are not fully understood, the chitinases are considered active immunomodulators across several cell types. Specific isoforms, including chitotriosidase-1 (CHIT1), chitinase-3-like protein 1 (CHI3L1), and human-specific chitinase-3-like protein 2 (CHI3L2), have emerged as markers of inflammation across the neurodegenerative spectrum, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). ALS is a fatal neuromuscular condition, and therapeutic development has been severely hindered by phenotypic heterogeneity and an incomplete understanding of aetiology. Although several overlapping disease mechanisms can contribute to neuronal death, inflammation can exacerbate pathology. Prior studies have reported that CHIT1, CHI3L1 and CHI3L2 levels are elevated in the CSF of ALS patients and associated with disease aggressiveness. Nevertheless, several open questions critical to our understanding of the role of chitinases in ALS disease burden remain: namely, (i) which cell types in the CNS are chitinase sources under physiological conditions; (ii) which of these display chitinase upregulation in ALS; and (iii) what is the diagnostic utility of the chitinases relative to established biomarkers. Here, we utilize preclinical models and post-mortem human tissue to demonstrate at both the transcriptomic and protein level that neurons are a primary source of chitinases; furthermore, neuronal chitinase expression is conserved across species. Under physiological conditions, CHI3L1 is more abundant and widely expressed across various cell types, whereas CHIT1 is predominantly expressed in neurons. Additionally, utilizing symptomatic mice from three familial ALS models, we demonstrate isoform-specific expression profiles, with astroglial and microglial upregulation of CHI3L1, and neuronal and microglial upregulation of CHIT1. Differing expression dynamics and diagnostic utility were also noted in our clinical cohort: CSF CHIT1 and CHI3L2 levels had more discriminatory power when distinguishing between ALS versus non-ALS controls, while CHI3L1 was more closely associated with inflammation and ageing across the neurodegenerative spectrum. Although the chitinases did not diagnostically outperform the neurofilament proteins, we posit that their expression profiles can inform the optimization of biomarker-guided trial design. Taken together, we demonstrate that chitinase upregulation in ALS is evident in various CNS cell types and that its neuronal expression may provide new insights into its role in disease activity.
items.titleZh: 几丁质酶在肌萎缩侧索硬化中的神经元组成性表达及疾病相关上调
items.summaryZh: 该研究结合临床前模型和ALS患者死后组织，发现神经元是几丁质酶的主要来源，且这种表达在物种间保守。在三种家族性ALS小鼠模型中，CHI3L1在星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中上调，CHIT1在神经元和小胶质细胞中上调。临床队列显示，脑脊液CHIT1和CHI3L2对区分ALS与非ALS对照的判别能力较强，而CHI3L1更反映炎症和衰老。几丁质酶的诊断性能未优于神经丝蛋白，但其表达谱可能有助于优化生物标志物指导的临床试验设计。
items.insight: 这项研究首次系统阐明了ALS中几丁质酶的细胞来源和亚型特异性上调模式，将神经元定位为CHIT1的主要来源，并揭示了不同几丁质酶亚型在诊断和炎症/衰老关联上的差异。对于ALS研究者而言，该工作提示几丁质酶不仅是炎症标志物，还可能参与神经元本身的疾病活动，其表达谱可用于患者分层和生物标志物指导的试验设计优化，尽管其诊断性能未超越神经丝蛋白。

items.abstractZh: 几丁质酶是负责降解几丁质的水解酶，在不同物种间进化上保守。尽管其信号通路尚未完全阐明，几丁质酶被认为在多种细胞类型中具有活跃的免疫调节作用。特定亚型，包括壳三糖苷酶-1（CHIT1）、几丁质酶-3样蛋白1（CHI3L1）和人特异性几丁质酶-3样蛋白2（CHI3L2），已成为包括肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）在内的神经退行性疾病谱系中的炎症标志物。ALS是一种致命的神经肌肉疾病，其治疗开发因表型异质性和对病因学认识不完整而严重受阻。尽管多种重叠的疾病机制可导致神经元死亡，但炎症可加剧病理过程。既往研究报道，ALS患者脑脊液中CHIT1、CHI3L1和CHI3L2水平升高，并与疾病侵袭性相关。然而，对于理解几丁质酶在ALS疾病负担中的作用，仍有若干关键问题尚未解决，即：（i）在生理条件下，中枢神经系统中哪些细胞类型是几丁质酶的来源；（ii）其中哪些在ALS中表现出几丁质酶上调；（iii）相对于已建立的生物标志物，几丁质酶的诊断效用如何。在此，我们利用临床前模型和死后人体组织，在转录组和蛋白质水平证明神经元是几丁质酶的主要来源；此外，神经元几丁质酶表达在物种间保守。在生理条件下，CHI3L1更为丰富并在多种细胞类型中广泛表达，而CHIT1主要表达于神经元。此外，利用三种家族性ALS模型的症状期小鼠，我们展示了亚型特异性表达谱，其中CHI3L1在星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中上调，CHIT1在神经元和小胶质细胞中上调。在我们的临床队列中也观察到不同的表达动态和诊断效用：脑脊液CHIT1和CHI3L2水平在区分ALS与非ALS对照时具有更强的判别能力，而CHI3L1与整个神经退行性疾病谱系中的炎症和衰老更密切相关。尽管几丁质酶的诊断性能未超过神经丝蛋白，但我们认为其表达谱可为优化生物标志物指导的试验设计提供信息。综上所述，我们证明ALS中几丁质酶上调 evident 于多种中枢神经系统细胞类型，其神经元表达可能为其在疾病活动中的作用提供新见解。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，结合临床前模型与患者组织，首次揭示ALS中几丁质酶的神经元来源及亚型特异性上调，为神经炎症机制和生物标志物指导的试验设计提供了新视角。

items.title: BTK inhibition suppresses neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a devastating neurodegenerative disorder with limited therapeutic interventions. Neuroinflammation represents a central pathogenic mechanism in ALS, yet the upstream molecular regulators that integrate multiple inflammatory cascades remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated whether Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK), which integrates DNA-sensing and Toll-like receptor signals upstream of the cGAS-STING-NF-κB cascade, serves as a key regulatory node in ALS pathogenesis. Public RNA sequencing datasets of motor neurons (MNs) and post-mortem tissues from ALS patients were utilized to identify BTK expression patterns. SOD1-mutant human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSC) were differentiated into MNs (hiPSC-MNs) and microglia (hiPSC-MGs). NF-κB dysregulation was profiled by scRNA sequencing (hiPSC-MGs) and bulk RNA sequencing (hiPSC-MNs). DNA damage (γH2AX), inflammatory signalling (western blot/ELISA) and phagocytosis (pH-rodo uptake) were quantified, and microglial-conditioned medium was tested for MN toxicity. Monocultures and MN-MG co-cultures received zanubrutinib (3 µM, 12 h). SOD1-G93A mice were administered zanubrutinib (30 mg/kg, daily) from 2.5 months; motor performance, survival, spinal histology and PI3K-AKT-mTOR activity were assessed after 2 months of treatment. ALS spinal cord and cortex tissues of patients, as well as SOD1-mutant hiPSC-MG and hiPSC-MNs, demonstrated elevated BTK phosphorylation with increased p-STING, p-TBK1 and nuclear NF-κB accumulation. ALS hiPSC-MG exhibited inflammatory activation, NLRP3 induction and impaired phagocytosis, while ALS hiPSC-MNs showed DNA damage and caspase-3-mediated apoptosis. Conditioned medium from inflammatory MG amplified neuronal STING-NF-κB activity and apoptosis, demonstrating non-cell-autonomous toxicity. The STING inhibitor H-151 reduced neuronal p-STING/p-TBK1/NF-κB and apoptosis, confirming pathway causality. Pharmacological BTK inhibition reduced DNA damage in ALS hiPSC-MNs by 61.4% (P < 0.05), restored phagocytosis in ALS hiPSC-MG to 87.2% of control levels (P < 0.01) and prevented neuronal apoptosis induced by microglial conditioned medium. In SOD1-G93A mice, BTK blockade extended median survival from 158 to 183 days (P < 0.01, log-rank test), improved motor function, and attenuated neuroinflammation while moderately rebalancing PI3K-AKT-mTOR signalling without impairing autophagy-lysosome dynamics. We identify BTK as a critical upstream regulator of the dysregulated cGAS-STING-NF-κB signalling axis characteristic of ALS pathogenesis. BTK orchestrates both cell-autonomous dysfunction in MNs and non-cell-autonomous toxicity through microglial activation, representing a convergent regulatory node that integrates multiple pathogenic pathways. These mechanistic insights provide a molecular framework for understanding ALS neuroinflammation and establish a rational basis for BTK-targeted therapeutic intervention in neurodegeneration.

items.titleZh: BTK抑制可减轻肌萎缩侧索硬化中的神经炎症和神经退行性变
items.summaryZh: 该研究结合ALS患者组织、SOD1突变hiPSC来源的运动神经元和小胶质细胞以及SOD1-G93A小鼠模型，发现BTK是cGAS-STING-NF-κB炎症通路的上游关键调控节点。BTK抑制可减轻运动神经元DNA损伤、恢复小胶质细胞吞噬功能、阻止非细胞自主毒性，并在小鼠中延长生存期、改善运动功能。
items.insight: 这项研究将BTK定位为ALS中整合DNA感知与固有免疫炎症的汇聚节点，并提供了从患者组织、人源细胞模型到小鼠模型的跨层次验证。zanubrutinib作为已获批的BTK抑制剂，其在该研究中的多维度保护效应为ALS神经炎症的靶向干预提供了可快速转化的候选策略，值得关注其后续临床评估。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种破坏性的神经退行性疾病，治疗手段有限。神经炎症是ALS的核心致病机制，但整合多种炎症级联反应的上游分子调控因子仍知之甚少。本研究探讨了布鲁顿酪氨酸激酶（BTK）——其在cGAS-STING-NF-κB级联上游整合DNA感知和Toll样受体信号——是否作为ALS发病机制中的关键调控节点。利用ALS患者运动神经元（MNs）和尸检组织的公共RNA测序数据集来鉴定BTK表达模式。将SOD1突变的人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）分化为运动神经元（hiPSC-MNs）和小胶质细胞（hiPSC-MGs）。通过单细胞RNA测序（hiPSC-MGs）和批量RNA测序（hiPSC-MNs）分析NF-κB失调。定量DNA损伤（γH2AX）、炎症信号（蛋白质印迹/ELISA）和吞噬作用（pH-rodo摄取），并检测小胶质细胞条件培养基对MN的毒性。单培养和MN-MG共培养接受zanubrutinib（3 µM，12小时）处理。SOD1-G93A小鼠从2.5个月龄起给予zanubrutinib（30 mg/kg，每日），治疗2个月后评估运动表现、生存期、脊髓组织学和PI3K-AKT-mTOR活性。ALS患者脊髓和皮层组织，以及SOD1突变hiPSC-MG和hiPSC-MNs，均显示BTK磷酸化升高，伴有p-STING、p-TBK1和核NF-κB积累增加。ALS hiPSC-MG表现出炎症激活、NLRP3诱导和吞噬功能受损，而ALS hiPSC-MNs显示DNA损伤和caspase-3介导的凋亡。炎症MG的条件培养基放大了神经元STING-NF-κB活性和凋亡，表明存在非细胞自主毒性。STING抑制剂H-151减少了神经元p-STING/p-TBK1/NF-κB和凋亡，证实了通路因果关系。药理学BTK抑制使ALS hiPSC-MNs中的DNA损伤减少61.4%（P < 0.05），使ALS hiPSC-MG的吞噬功能恢复至对照水平的87.2%（P < 0.01），并阻止了小胶质细胞条件培养基诱导的神经元凋亡。在SOD1-G93A小鼠中，BTK阻断将中位生存期从158天延长至183天（P < 0.01，log-rank检验），改善了运动功能，减轻了神经炎症，同时适度重新平衡PI3K-AKT-mTOR信号，而不损害自噬-溶酶体动态。我们将BTK确定为ALS发病机制中失调的cGAS-STING-NF-κB信号轴的关键上游调控因子。BTK协调MNs中的细胞自主功能障碍和通过小胶质细胞激活介导的非细胞自主毒性，代表了一个整合多种致病通路的汇聚调控节点。这些机制性见解为理解ALS神经炎症提供了分子框架，并为BTK靶向治疗神经退行性变奠定了合理基础。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了BTK作为ALS中cGAS-STING-NF-κB炎症轴上游汇聚节点的机制，并在人源细胞和SOD1小鼠模型中验证了已获批BTK抑制剂的转化潜力。

items.title: Missense variants in TUBA4A cause myo-tubulinopathies.
items.summary: Tubulinopathies encompass a spectrum of disorders resulting from variants in genes encoding α- and β-tubulins, the key components of microtubules. While previous studies have linked de novo or dominantly inherited TUBA4A missense variants to neurodegenerative phenotypes, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, frontotemporal dementia, spastic ataxia, and recently, an isolated congenital myopathy, the full phenotypic and genotypic spectrum of TUBA4A-related disorders remains incompletely characterized. In this multi-centre study, we identified one previously reported and 12 novel TUBA4A missense variants in 31 individuals from 19 unrelated families. Remarkably, individuals in 17 families presented with a myopathy without any CNS involvement or history of such disease. In the remaining two families, we observed probands with cerebellar ataxia and epilepsy accompanying proximal and axial muscle weakness along with protein aggregation. The coexistence of neuromuscular and neurodegenerative features with protein aggregation defines a multisystem proteinopathy. These two families thus establish the first association between TUBA4A and multisystem proteinopathy. Our cohort exhibited diverse genotypes and inheritance patterns: four families demonstrated autosomal dominant transmission through heterozygous variants in TUBA4A, three probands had recessive inheritance due to homozygous variants, while the respective heterozygous carriers were asymptomatic; five probands carried de novo variants and nine probands with heterozygous variants were classified as sporadic cases. Clinical phenotypes ranged from mild to severe myopathy, predominantly affecting the axial and paraspinal muscles. We observed a range of disease onset, from congenital to late adulthood. Creatine kinase levels were variable, ranging from normal to highly elevated. Cardiac function remained preserved across the cohort. Muscle biopsies showed heterogenous myopathic changes, including myofibre size variation, nemaline bodies, core-like regions and internal nuclei. Immunohistochemical analysis revealed protein accumulations positive for TDP-43 (n = 2), p62 (n = 5) and TUBA4A (n = 6). Complementary in silico and in vitro investigations suggested that the identified TUBA4A variants cause significant protein abnormalities and may differentially impact microtubule dynamics. Correlation analyses integrating clinical severity, variant location and mechanistic readouts further demonstrated that domain specificity within TUBA4A influences both the pattern of muscle involvement and the extent of microtubule disruption. Our findings establish myo-tubulinopathies as distinct clinical entities, encompassing both primary myopathies and multisystem proteinopathies with muscle involvement. This study broadens the phenotypic and genotypic spectrum of TUBA4A-related disorders beyond autosomal dominant or de novo mechanisms and neurodegenerative presentations. These results underscore the importance of considering TUBA4A variants in the differential diagnosis of axial myopathies and multisystem proteinopathies, regardless of CNS involvement.

items.titleZh: TUBA4A错义变异导致肌微管蛋白病
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心研究在31名个体中鉴定出13个TUBA4A错义变异，发现大多数患者表现为无中枢神经系统受累的原发性肌病，而两个家族则表现为伴小脑性共济失调、癫痫和蛋白聚集的多系统蛋白病。研究首次将TUBA4A与多系统蛋白病相关联，并发现该基因相关疾病可呈常染色体显性、隐性、新发或散发等多种遗传模式，表型从先天性到成年晚期不等。肌肉活检可见TDP-43、p62和TUBA4A阳性蛋白聚集，提示蛋白稳态异常在发病中起作用。
items.insight: 该研究将TUBA4A相关疾病谱从既往认识的ALS、FTD等神经退行性表型大幅扩展至以轴性肌病为主、可无中枢神经系统受累的肌微管蛋白病，并首次报道TUBA4A与多系统蛋白病（伴TDP-43、p62阳性聚集）的关联。对于ALS研究者而言，这提示TUBA4A变异携带者可能以纯肌肉表型就诊而被漏诊，也提示微管动力学异常与TDP-43蛋白稳态之间存在潜在交叉，值得在ALS遗传筛查和蛋白病机制研究中进一步关注。

items.abstractZh: 微管蛋白病涵盖了一系列由编码α-和β-微管蛋白（微管的关键组分）的基因变异所导致的疾病谱。既往研究已将新发或显性遗传的TUBA4A错义变异与神经退行性表型相关联，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化、额颞叶痴呆、痉挛性共济失调，以及近期报道的孤立性先天性肌病，但TUBA4A相关疾病的完整表型和基因型谱仍未被充分表征。在这项多中心研究中，我们在来自19个无关家族的31名个体中鉴定出1个既往报道的和12个新的TUBA4A错义变异。值得注意的是，17个家族的个体表现为肌病，无任何中枢神经系统受累或此类疾病史。在其余两个家族中，我们观察到先证者伴有小脑性共济失调和癫痫，同时伴有近端和轴性肌无力以及蛋白聚集。神经肌肉和神经退行性特征与蛋白聚集的共存定义了多系统蛋白病。这两个家族因此首次建立了TUBA4A与多系统蛋白病之间的关联。我们的队列表现出多样的基因型和遗传模式：4个家族通过TUBA4A杂合变异表现为常染色体显性遗传，3名先证者因纯合变异表现为隐性遗传，而相应的杂合携带者无症状；5名先证者携带新发变异，9名携带杂合变异的先证者被归类为散发病例。临床表型从轻度到重度肌病不等，主要累及轴性和椎旁肌肉。我们观察到发病年龄范围从先天性到成年晚期。肌酸激酶水平可变，从正常到高度升高。整个队列中心脏功能保持完好。肌肉活检显示异质性肌病性改变，包括肌纤维大小变异、线状体、核心样区域和内核。免疫组化分析显示蛋白聚集物对TDP-43（n=2）、p62（n=5）和TUBA4A（n=6）呈阳性。互补的计算机模拟和体外研究提示，所鉴定的TUBA4A变异导致显著的蛋白异常，并可能对微管动力学产生差异性影响。整合临床严重程度、变异位置和机制读出值的相关性分析进一步表明，TUBA4A内的结构域特异性影响肌肉受累模式和微管破坏程度。我们的发现确立了肌微管蛋白病作为独特的临床实体，涵盖原发性肌病和伴肌肉受累的多系统蛋白病。本研究将TUBA4A相关疾病的表型和基因型谱扩展到常染色体显性或新发机制及神经退行性表现之外。这些结果强调，在轴性肌病和多系统蛋白病的鉴别诊断中应考虑TUBA4A变异，无论是否存在中枢神经系统受累。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于新近多中心队列，将TUBA4A相关疾病谱扩展至无中枢神经系统受累的肌病及多系统蛋白病，对ALS遗传诊断和蛋白稳态机制研究具有直接转化价值。
